text: {"lessons":["Selling a stock just because it is above my average cost can cut short further gains; I should judge each holding by its prospects, not its separate-account profit or loss.","A few months of gains or declines are not reliable signals about what prices will do next, so I should avoid overreacting to short-term account changes.","Before trading, I should weigh the whole portfolio and the cash available, rather than letting reluctance to admit a loss or attachment to a winning position drive my decisions."]}
